title: CISSP practice question (authoring form)
description: One question as authored in content/domain-N.json. Each content file is a JSON array of these objects. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express cleanly (the id digit must equal `domain`, the objective prefix must equal `domain`, ids must be unique across the whole corpus) are enforced by tools/build.mjs.

id.description: Permanent identifier. The digit after 'D' must equal `domain`. Never renumbered, never reused: user progress is keyed on it.

domain.description: CISSP domain number per the ISC2 exam outline effective 15 April 2024.

objective.description: Syllabus section from the published outline, e.g. '1.10'. Must exist in content/syllabus.json and belong to `domain` — the build enforces both. Bare domain numbers are not allowed.

stem.description: Scenario-framed question text. Qualifiers are capitalised: BEST, MOST, FIRST, LEAST.

options.description: Exactly four distinct options of comparable length. 'All of the above' / 'None of the above' are forbidden.

answer.description: Index into `options` of the correct answer. Display order is shuffled at runtime, so authored position carries no signal.

explanations.description: One per option, same order. The entry at the `answer` index explains why it is correct; each other entry names the specific confusion behind that distractor and corrects it.

reference.description: Optional citation to a public standard or the exam outline, e.g. 'NIST SP 800-88r1'.
